blocks.text: The Netherlands' national museum, in Amsterdam.

Its old collection API answers HTTP 410 Gone, and the replacement needs a registered key this work did not have, so nothing was taken. Nothing here is a judgement about the museum: it is simply a door that needs a key. The one object on this page a reader might expect to find in Amsterdam, the Ipuwer Papyrus, is in fact in the Rijksmuseum van Oudheden in Leiden, which is a different institution and has its own page.
Records and photographs are the museums' and archives' own, used under the licences each one states. A record here is a record, not an endorsement of any reading of the object.
